findings.body:
v5t's [A1] (a config: claude epic runs its workers on sonnet/opus via the subscription in the cloud, stepping down to Workers AI) is built and tested at the seam but has never run: the factory deploys main only. Proposed epic, per the planning learnings: (1) first ticks: 8qi (bump the image's claude CLI so the aliases resolve to 5.5) and a NAMED operator step setting at least one CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> Worker secret; (2) uuk (rival worker past the 2h lease TTL) and eov (a claude config with no token passes silently when the factory cannot be asked) before the run; (3) a named tick INSIDE the epic runs a real `config: claude` epic in the cloud and a GLM epic beside it, comparing escalation and cost on status; (4) km9, 5ww, 0iu, lrb, oqn, 2zs, k20, jwq, and o3f closing bw7 as the tail; (5) 7vp/lxo so a routing-file deliverable is never again a dispatched tick. Acceptance: the live claude run completes with workers on the subscription and a forced full pool steps one job down to GLM 5.3, visible in the run feed.
evidence: image/Dockerfile:53 ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.227; .tick/issues/8qi.json, uuk.json, eov.json; docs/v5t-closeout-retro-2026-10-07.md
findings.title: Next epic: claude-sub's first live cloud run, post-merge proof of v5t [A1]

findings.body:
The run makes one tick per blocking finding. v5t's round-1 review named two findings on ONE seam (the claude-sub step-down, Go side and TS side); they became y38 and yhe in parallel, needed a resolve-conflict job on internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/model_test.go, and yhe filed a duplicate HIGH finding (bw7) for the defect y38 had just fixed, which then needed o3f to close it. 2jn paid the same shape at 16 ticks and 7 resolves. The learning 'fold by seam' exists but nothing applies it mechanically: the run should group a NOT READY's blocking findings whose evidence names overlapping files (or packages on both sides of one contract) into one tick, or at least serialize them.
evidence: .ticfac/runs/epic-v5t/decisions/7.json (two blocking findings); decisions/10.json (resolve of model_test.go between yhe and y38); .tick/issues/bw7.json, o3f.json
findings.title: Fold a NOT READY review's blocking findings that share a seam into one tick

findings.body:
standing_orders.go's money class lists "$" as a subject, and containsWord matches a punctuation-only phrase anywhere. yck's ceiling BLOCKED question quoted `sed -n '/^# Named run configs/,$p' ...`, so the hold was recorded under class 'Spending money'. The outcome (hold for a person) was right for another reason (the deliverable was outside the worker boundary), but any question quoting a shell command, regex or $VAR holds as a money question and tells the person the wrong thing. Match '$' only beside a digit (\$\d) or drop it.
evidence: internal/reconcile/standing_orders.go:143 ("$" in the money subjects) and containsWord's punctuation-only branch; .ticfac/runs/epic-v5t/decisions/6.json response.class "Spending money"
findings.title: A '$' in a BLOCKED question's shell command classifies it as Spending money

findings.body:
Epic djo (subscription seats as flat-rate credentials, via omp's auth broker) predates jvj's spike and v5t, which deliver the Claude half differently: a factory-held CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> with leases and a Workers AI step-down, no broker. What remains is Codex/ChatGPT seats and the broker question. An operator decision: rescope djo to Codex seats on v5t's rung design, or close it.
evidence: .tick/issues/djo.json; docs/spikes/jvj-claude-sub-cloud.md; .tick/runners.cloud.toml [configs.claude]
findings.title: Rescope or close djo (Phase 5b): its Claude half shipped as jvj + v5t

response.summary: [A1] is built and reviewed READY but not demonstrated live: it needs the merge, the operator's CLAUDE_SUB_TOKEN_<LABEL> secret and 8qi's CLI bump before a real config: claude cloud run (finding 1)
